comments.headline: Site Plan Approval block requires corrections and verification
comments.summary: The approval block on the cover sheet is incomplete and contains errors across multiple fields, including missing development zone designation, prohibited language, unchecked approval authority checkboxes, unverified case manager information, and incorrect departmental signature titles.
comments.crossDep: Development Services (case manager verification); Austin Fire Department (signature title); Austin Water (force main authority determination)
comments.attn: ZLU-2.2 and ZLU-2.16 both address approval authority checkbox; Run 2 determination (ADMINISTRATIVELY per § 25-5-112) provides definitive resolution. Confirm current case manager assignment (Runs 1/3 not-verifiable). Verify whether force main components exist in utility plans.

details.text: The approval block lacks the required 'Desired Development Zone' (DDZ) designation. The site is located in West Bouldin Creek Watershed (Urban classification), which mandates DDZ identification per code.

runComments.comment: The approval block does not include a field or designation for 'DDZ' (Desired Development Zone). The project is located in the West Bouldin Creek Watershed (Urban classification), which places it within the Desired Development Zone. The approval block must include a DDZ designation field with 'DDZ' marked or stated.

The approval block lacks the required 'DDZ' (Desired Development Zone) designation. The site is located in West Bouldin Creek Watershed, classified as Urban, which places it in the Desired Development Zone per LDC § 25-1-21(29). The approval block must include and clearly identify the DDZ designation.

The Site Plan Approval block on the cover sheet fails to identify the site's development zone classification. Per facts.md, the site is located within the West Bouldin Creek watershed (Urban classification, non-water-supply), which places it within the Desired Development Zone (DDZ). The approval block must explicitly state "DDZ" to satisfy code requirements.

details.text: The approval block contains prohibited language 'RELEASED FOR GENERAL COMPLIANCE' which is not compatible with formal site plan approval blocks and must be removed entirely.

runComments.comment: The site plan approval block contains the text 'RELEASED FOR GENERAL COMPLIANCE' which must be removed. This language is not part of the formal approval block structure and must be deleted from the plans before resubmittal.
The approval block contains the prohibited text 'RELEASED FOR GENERAL COMPLIANCE' followed by a blank signature line. This language must be removed from the approval block entirely.

The Site Plan Approval block includes the text "RELEASED FOR GENERAL COMPLIANCE," which must be removed. This language is not compatible with formal site plan approval blocks and conflicts with development services procedures.

details.text: Both 'ADMINISTRATIVELY' and 'BY COMMISSION' approval checkboxes are left blank. The appropriate box must be marked to indicate whether the project qualifies for administrative (Director) approval or requires Commission approval.

runComments.comment: Approval block shows 'UNDER SECTION 112 OF CHAPTER 25-5' language but both authorization checkboxes (ADMINISTRATIVELY / BY COMMISSION) are left blank. The applicant must clearly indicate whether the project qualifies for administrative (Director) approval per § 25-5-112 or requires Land Use Commission approval per § 25-5-142, and the correct checkbox must be marked.

details.text: The 'ADMINISTRATIVELY' checkbox is not checked. The project qualifies for administrative (Director) approval under LDC § 25-5-112, and this checkbox must be marked with the section reference citing § 25-5-112 only.

runComments.comment: The approval block contains unchecked checkboxes for 'ADMINISTRATIVELY' and 'BY COMMISSION' approval. The project qualifies for administrative (Director) approval per LDC § 25-5-112 and requires no Land Use Commission action. The 'ADMINISTRATIVELY' checkbox must be checked to indicate the correct approval basis, and the section reference must clearly cite LDC § 25-5-112 only.

details.text: The approval block lists 'Jim Gobel' as case manager, but current case manager assignment cannot be verified from submitted documents and must be confirmed against the DSD case management system.

runComments.comment: The approval block lists 'Jim Gobel' as the case manager. The applicant's submittal does not contain sufficient documentation to verify whether this individual is the currently assigned case manager for case SP-2025-0126C. Confirmation of current case manager assignment must be obtained through DSD records.

The case manager name "Jim Gobel" appears in the approval block, but cannot be verified from submitted plan documents as the currently assigned case manager for this project. The case manager assignment must be confirmed against the current DSD case management system to ensure accuracy.

details.text: Cannot determine from submitted documents whether force main components are present in the utility plans. If force main facilities exist, an 'Austin Water Facility Engineering' signature line with date field is required on both the cover sheet and each sheet containing force main components.

runComments.comment: The presence or absence of force main components in the utility plans cannot be determined from available documents. If force main components are present, the "Austin Water Facility Engineering" signature line with a Date field must appear on both the cover sheet and each sheet containing force main components. The utility plan sheets must be reviewed to verify whether this signature line is required.

details.text: The Fire Department signature line incorrectly reads 'City of Austin Fire Department' and must be corrected to read 'Austin Fire Department' to match departmental naming conventions.

runComments.comment: The Austin Fire Department signature line text reads "City of Austin Fire Department" instead of the required "Austin Fire Department." The signature line must be corrected to read "Austin Fire Department" to match standard departmental naming conventions.

comments.headline: Non-cover sheets lack required batch stamping space
comments.summary: All non-cover sheets throughout the plan set fail to reserve the required blank space in the lower right corner for City batch stamping. Engineer seals, approval blocks, title blocks, and project information currently occupy this area on examined sheets.

details.text: Sampled non-cover sheets lack required blank space in lower right corner for City batch stamping. A minimum 3.5 × 5 inch rectangular area (or 1 × 1 inch alternative) must be reserved on all 38 non-cover sheets; engineer seals, approval blocks, and project information must be cleared from this area.

runComments.comment: Non-cover sheets (Sheets 2, 3, 9, 11, 15 examined) do not reserve blank space in the lower right corner for batch stamping. All examined sheets have the lower right corner fully occupied by the professional engineer's seal, project information blocks, and design credentials. A minimum 3.5 inches × 5 inches blank rectangular space must be reserved in the lower right corner of each non-cover sheet for City batch stamping; a 1 inch × 1 inch alternative is acceptable. This requirement applies to all 38 non-cover sheets.

Multiple non-cover sheets (Sheets 2, 9, 12 verified; others not individually examined) do not reserve a blank space in the lower right corner for batch stamping. The required space is minimum 3.5" × 5" (or 1" × 1" as an acceptable alternative). Case Manager Comment CM 10 (dated U1) confirms this requirement remains uncleared, with notation that 'an undefined area is provided on some sheets but these areas need to be on all pages.' Full approval blocks and other content must be removed from the batch-stamp area to ensure space is reserved for City use.

Multiple non-cover plan sheets lack the required blank batch stamp space in the lower right corner. Sheets 2, 9, 11, and 12 show engineer seals, title blocks, and project tracking information occupying the lower right corner instead of reserving a minimum 3.5"×5" blank space (or alternative 1"×1") for City of Austin batch stamping. All non-cover sheets must reserve this space in the lower right corner and may not include full approval blocks.
